1088.description: A pull-up using suspension handles. It builds the lats and arms.
instructions: Hang from the handles with arms extended.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest up between the handles.
Lead with your elbows.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

1152.description: You pull the knees up and twist across the body from a plank with the feet in the straps.
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Pull your knees up and rotate them toward one elbow.
Pause and squeeze the obliques.
Extend your legs back to plank.
Repeat to the other side.
Keep your hands firmly planted.

1216.description: A one-leg seated calf raise on a machine. Working each leg alone helps balance strength and targets the soleus.
instructions: Sit on the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform.
Set the pad on your thigh and release the safety.
Lower your heel for a stretch.
Press up as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause, lower slowly, then switch legs.

1280.description: One-arm incline fly with your back supported on a stability ball. The unstable base adds a core challenge to the upper chest stretch.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with a dumbbell in one hand.
Walk your feet forward and roll your body down until your head, neck, and upper back are supported on the ball.
Hold the dumbbell with your arm extended straight up over your chest, palm facing inwards.
Slowly lower the dumbbell out to the side, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Pause for a moment when your arm is parallel to the ground.
Engage your chest muscles to bring the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，一只手拿着哑铃。
双脚向前走，身体向下滚动，直到头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
握住哑铃，手臂伸直越过胸部，手掌朝内。
慢慢地将哑铃向一侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
当手臂与地面平行时暂停片刻。
启动胸部肌肉，将哑铃拉回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1344.description: A bent over row with an ez barbell and an underhand grip. It targets the upper back and lats with extra work for the biceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and hands shoulder-width apart.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up, until your torso is almost parallel to the floor.
Pull the ez barbell towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the ez barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
反手握住 ez 杠铃，手掌朝上，双手与肩同宽。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，挺胸，直到躯干几乎与地板平行。
将 ez 杠铃拉向下胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将 ez 杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1408.description: Lie on your back with a band around your thighs and lift your hips. It strengthens the glutes and the outer hips.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place a resistance band just above your knees.
Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Press your heels into the ground and lift your hips off the floor, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将阻力带放在膝盖上方。
调动你的臀肌和核心肌肉。
将脚后跟压入地面，将臀部抬离地板，在顶部挤压臀部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1472.description: A bodyweight jump forward with a soft landing. It builds explosive power in the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Swing your arms back for momentum.
Jump forward explosively, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next jump.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
向后摆动手臂以获得动力。
爆发性地向前跳跃，伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝。
脚掌轻轻落地，然后立即进入下一个跳跃。
重复所需的重复次数。

1536.description: A snatch started from blocks. It trains the pull and the deep overhead catch.
instructions: Set the bar on blocks and take a wide grip with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead in a full squat, then stand up.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

1600.description: A jump for distance from a standing start. It builds explosive power in the hips and legs.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart at a clear starting line.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Swing your arms forward and jump as far as you can.
Land on both feet with your knees bent to absorb the impact.
Reset and repeat.

1664.description: A dumbbell curl lifted high toward the shoulder. It trains the peak of the biceps contraction.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your upper arms stationary and curl the dumbbells as high as possible while contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
保持上臂静止，将哑铃尽可能高地卷起，同时收缩二头肌。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1728.description: A two-arm triceps kickback with cables. It gives constant tension to the triceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the cable handle in each hand with your palms facing inwards and your arms bent at a 90-degree angle.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, extend your forearms backwards until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝内，手臂弯曲成 90 度角。
保持上臂静止，向后伸展前臂，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1792.description: Wrapping one arm across your body and hooking it with the other stretches the back of the shoulder and upper back.
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest at shoulder height.
Hook it with your other forearm and pull it gently closer to your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1856.description: Machine-based lying leg raise with bent knees that loads the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie back on the machine and grip the handles.
Bend your knees and place your legs under the pads.
Curl your knees up toward your chest.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly until you feel tension, then repeat.

1920.description: Pointing the foot downward to stretch the front of the ankle and shin.
instructions: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you as far as is comfortable.
Gently press the top of the foot with your hand for a little extra stretch.
Keep the movement slow and avoid forcing the ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1984.description: A stretch aimed at the small stabilizing muscles around the shoulder joint.
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your body at chest height.
Hold the arm just above the elbow with the other hand and draw it in until the back of the shoulder stretches.
Keep the shoulder blade down and relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2112.description: Lifts the hips while the upper back is supported, teaching the glutes to extend the hip through a full range.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your arms by your sides for support.
Push through your heels and lift the hips until the body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without arching the lower back.
Lower the hips back down with control.
Repeat for 10-12 reps.

2304.description: A kick with the back leg that rises high and then drops down like an axe, training flexibility and control.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Swing your rear leg straight up in front of you.
Reach the top with the leg extended.
Bring the heel sharply down.
Keep your supporting leg slightly bent and balanced.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

2368.description: A bodyweight split squat with a long stance. Builds the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with one foot and place it about two feet in front of the other foot.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight.
Continue lowering until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, and your back knee is hovering just above the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
一只脚向前迈出一步，并将其放在另一只脚前面约两英尺处。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，保持背部挺直。
继续降低，直到前大腿与地面平行，后膝盖悬停在地面上方。
暂停片刻，然后推动前脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。

2432.description: A close-grip bench press with an EZ bar. Targets the triceps with less wrist strain.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the ez barbell with a close grip, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing forward.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Slowly lower the barbell towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
紧握杠铃，双手与肩同宽，掌心向前。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其直接放在胸部上方，双臂完全伸展。
慢慢地将杠铃降低到胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

2560.description: A deep squat down to a bench that builds the legs and hips.
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and lower until you touch the bench.
Pause briefly without relaxing.
Push through your heels to stand.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2752.description: A static lunge-style squat that trains the legs one at a time with balance and control.
instructions: Stand in a long stride with one foot forward and one back.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front heel to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

2880.description: A quadruped Pilates move with opposite arm and leg lifts for back stability.
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Flutter them in small, quick pulses.
Keep your spine neutral and your hips level.
Switch sides and repeat.

2944.description: A push-up where your hands lift off the floor and reach out at the top. It builds chest and back strength together.
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs straight.
Push your upper body up with your arms like a seal.
Keep your hips on the floor and your core tight.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat for smooth, controlled reps.

3200.description: A machine row done in a bent-over stance with a v-bar handle. It builds the upper back and lats by pulling the handle toward your abdomen.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself facing the machine.
Grasp the v-bar with an overhand grip, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Pull the v-bar towards your abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the weight back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己面向机器。
正手握住 V 形杆，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将 V 形杆拉向腹部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢释放重量回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3264.description: Hold a side plank and lift the top leg to work the outer hips and the side of your trunk.
instructions: Lie on your side and prop yourself up on one forearm with elbow under the shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise your top leg to about hip height, toes pointing forward.
Lower it a little without dropping your hips.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3328.description: A barbell complex that links a stiff leg deadlift into a clean and then a step. It builds posterior chain power and rhythm.
instructions: Stand holding a light barbell with an overhand grip at thigh height.
Lower the bar down your legs with soft knees and a flat back.
Stand up, then pull the bar explosively and catch it on your shoulders.
Take a controlled step forward with the bar racked.
Step back, lower the bar and begin the next round.

3392.description: A close-stance squat with your heels raised on a small step to emphasize the quads.
instructions: Stand with your heels on a low platform and your feet close together.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down, keeping your knees over your toes.
Go as deep as comfortable with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet.
Stand tall without locking out hard.

3584.description: A side plank with the top arm and leg swinging, challenging the obliques and balance.
instructions: Lie on one side and prop yourself on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Raise the top leg and arm.
Swing them toward each other under control.
Keep your hips high, then switch sides.

3712.description: Raise your heel on one leg while holding a support for balance, building the calf.
instructions: Stand on one foot and hold a wall or rail for balance.
Rise as high as you can onto the ball of your foot.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly below flat if you can do so comfortably.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3776.description: Side steps in a half squat while holding the band out in front of you. It works your hips and resists rotation through the core.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Press the handle straight out and sink into a quarter squat.
Take small steps sideways away from the anchor, keeping your torso square.
Step back in under control.
Repeat for your set, then switch sides.

3904.description: A pike push-up with the hands on two benches so you can lower deeper, building the shoulders.
instructions: Place your hands on two benches shoulder-width apart and your feet on the floor.
Lift your hips into a pike shape.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between the benches.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Keep your hips high throughout.

3968.description: Sweep dumbbells from your hips to overhead in a wide arc on a flat bench. It works the shoulders and chest through a long range.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower them out and back in a wide arc.
Take them down toward your hips.
Reverse the arc with control.

4096.description: A lying core move with your feet pressed against a wall, tapping each heel alternately to challenge your lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hips and knees bent at 90 degrees and feet flat on a wall.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one heel to tap the floor while the other foot stays on the wall.
Return and tap with the other heel.
Move slowly without arching your back.

4160.description: Hold a squat while lifting and lowering your heels. It combines quad endurance with calf work.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and lower into a half squat.
Hold that depth with your chest up.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly.
Repeat while holding the squat position.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

4224.description: A Pallof press done lying on your back that resists rotation. It strengthens the deep core and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back beside a low cable pulley with a handle in both hands.
Hold the handle at your chest, arms bent.
Brace your core to stay flat.
Press your arms straight up while resisting the cable pull.
Hold a second, then bring the handle back to your chest.
Finish your reps and switch sides.

4288.description: A stretch that rounds the middle back and spreads the shoulder blades. It relieves tension from sitting or rowing.
instructions: Stand or sit and clasp your hands in front of you.
Straighten your arms and push them forward.
Round your upper back and tuck your chin.
Feel the stretch between your shoulder blades.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly and repeat.

4352.description: A dip where your hands rest on a bench behind you and your feet stay on the floor. It builds the back of the upper arms.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your back to a bench and place your hands on its edge.
Lift your hips and extend your legs slightly in front.
Bend your elbows and lower your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

4416.description: A bird dog variation where the leg slides along the floor, improving core stability and coordination.
instructions: Start on all fours with a sliding disc or towel under one foot.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Slide that leg straight back as you extend the opposite arm forward.
Return to the start in a controlled way.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

4480.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the muscles beside the lower spine (erector spinae). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your muscles beside the lower spine (erector spinae) while lying on your back.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep the ball beside the spine, never on it.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4544.description: An incline press using a band for resistance, targeting the upper chest and front shoulders.
instructions: Set an incline bench and anchor a band behind it or under the bench.
Sit back with the band handles at chest level.
Brace your core and keep your shoulder blades pulled together.
Press the handles up and slightly forward until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly back to the start, feeling the band pull.
Keep your wrists straight throughout.

4608.description: A seated hip rotation drill where you switch both knees from one side to the other, loosening the hips.
instructions: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front and one to the side.
Sit tall and keep your hands on the floor if needed.
Rotate your knees to the other side so the legs swap positions.
Move smoothly without using your hands to push too hard.
Repeat back and forth for the set.

4672.description: Pulling your elbows behind you to open up the chest and front of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall with your hands behind your head and elbows pointing out.
Draw your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your chest slightly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Relax and repeat.

4736.description: A combo of a deep push-up on dumbbells and a renegade row. It trains chest, back and core together.
instructions: Start in a plank with hands on two dumbbells, feet wide.
Lower your chest between the dumbbells in a deep push-up.
Press back up to a plank.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs while bracing to stay level.
Lower it, row the other side, and repeat.

4800.description: Face-up bridge on hands and feet that lifts the hips into a table shape. It builds the glutes, hamstrings and shoulder stability.
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet flat, hands behind you with fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press through your hands and heels to lift your hips.
Raise until your torso and thighs are level like a tabletop.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your head in line with your spine.
Hold briefly, then lower your hips back to the floor under control.

4864.description: A sumo deadlift standing on a low platform. It increases range of motion off the floor.
instructions: Stand on a low platform with a wide stance and toes out.
Grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace and push the floor away.
Lock your hips out.
Lower the bar under control.

4928.description: A seated stretch for the calves, a second variation. It helps loosen tight lower legs.
instructions: Sit with one leg straight in front of you.
Loop your hands or a strap around the ball of your foot.
Gently pull your toes toward you.
Feel the stretch in the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

4992.description: Crunch where opposite arm and leg move toward each other. It hits the abs and obliques together.
instructions: Lie on your back with hands lightly behind your head.
Lift one leg bent while curling your torso up.
Bring the opposite elbow toward the raised knee.
Lower slowly with control.
Alternate sides on each rep.

5120.description: Kick one leg straight back against a cable with an ankle strap. It isolates the glutes.
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and hold the machine for support.
Stand tall with a slight bend in the standing knee.
Kick your working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly and switch legs after your reps.

5312.description: A reverse lunge starting from a raised platform so you go deeper. Great for glutes and quads.
instructions: Stand on a low step with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and down off the step.
Lower until the front thigh is about parallel.
Keep your torso tall and front knee stable.
Push through the front heel to return to the step.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

5376.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the chest. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie lengthwise on the roller along your spine with knees bent.
Place the roller under the chest and let your body weight settle onto it.
Open your arms out to the sides and let your chest relax.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5632.description: Upright row with a shoulder-width grip.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs with hands shoulder width.
Pull the bar up along your body.
Lead with your elbows up to chest height.
Lower slowly.
Keep the bar close.

5696.description: A heavier biceps curl that uses a small hip swing to get the bar past the sticking point. It lets you overload the biceps on the way up.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, arms straight.
Lean back slightly and swing your hips to start the lift.
Curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower the bar slowly, resisting its weight.
Reset your posture before the next rep.

5888.description: A low plank where the elbows are bent back by your ribs. Builds strength in the arms, chest and core.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your wrists under your shoulders.
Shift slightly forward on your toes.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower to elbow height.
Keep your body in one line and your elbows near your ribs.
Hold briefly, then press back up.

6016.description: A crunch with a rotation to bring each elbow toward the opposite knee. Works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Twist to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides for your reps.

6144.description: A crunch with your arms straight overhead holding a dumbbell. The load increases the demand on the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell with straight arms over your chest.
Curl your upper back off the floor, reaching up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

6208.description: A side plank on the left side with the top leg lifted. It trains the obliques, hips and shoulder stability.
instructions: Lie on your left side and prop up on your left forearm, elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips into a straight line.
Raise your top leg to hip height.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides if you like.

6272.description: Dumbbell bench press done with your legs held out in the air, so your chest and triceps do all the work without help from the lower body.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and lie back.
Press the dumbbells up and lift your feet off the floor, legs extended.
Lower the weights to the sides of your chest with control.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core braced so your lower back does not arch.

6336.description: A squat that goes down slowly and then jumps up fast, training control, leg strength and power together.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat over about three seconds.
Pause briefly at the bottom with your chest up.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next rep.

6464.description: A glute bridge with the soles of your feet together and knees open, which shifts the focus onto your glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Keep your feet close to your hips.
Push through your feet to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

7232.description: A standing drill that moves the shoulder blades in circles. It improves shoulder mobility and control.
instructions: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Roll them back, then down.
Bring them forward and up again in a circle.
Reverse the direction after several reps.

7552.description: Rear-foot elevated split squat with the barbell in your elbow crooks.
instructions: Rest the barbell in the crooks of your elbows.
Put your rear foot on a bench.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your chest up.
Drive up and switch legs.

7744.description: A standing face pull using a rope with an underhand grip. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back, and is gentle on the wrists.
instructions: Set the rope at face height and grip it with your palms facing up.
Step back and stand tall.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows leading.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
Return slowly to the start.

8192.description: A deadlift with a wide stance holding a dumbbell between your legs. It works the glutes, inner thighs and back.
instructions: Stand with a wide stance, toes turned out, and a dumbbell between your feet.
Hinge down and grab it with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the weight under control.

8704.description: A burpee that finishes with a jump onto a box, great for full-body conditioning.
instructions: Stand facing a box.
Drop into a squat, kick your feet back and lower into a push-up.
Jump your feet back in.
Explode up and jump onto the box.
Step down carefully and repeat.

8896.description: From a bent over position you raise your torso and squeeze the shoulder blades together. It strengthens the whole back chain.
instructions: Stand and hinge forward with a flat back and your arms hanging.
Keep your knees softly bent.
Raise your torso toward upright.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower back to the bent over position slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.

9024.description: Lying on your back, you crunch up while scissoring your legs. It works the upper and lower abs together.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and your legs slightly off the floor.
Scissor your legs up and down in alternating motion.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set count of reps.

9408.description: Quick, low hops on the spot that keep your feet barely off the floor. They warm up the calves and ankles and build bouncy reactive strength.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Hop up a few centimetres by pushing through the balls of your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and rebound straight away.
Keep your knees almost straight and your chest tall.
Continue for 20-30 seconds at a quick, steady rhythm.

10048.description: A step-up with cable resistance that adds load to the legs and hips.
instructions: Stand facing a box or bench with a cable handle in your hands.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through that heel to step up.
Stand tall on top of the box.
Step back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10112.description: A one-arm seated cable row that keeps the pull in the lats. Great for fixing side-to-side strength gaps.
instructions: Sit at the cable station with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Sit tall and let the arm extend with a slight stretch in the lat.
Pull your elbow down and back toward your hip, leading with the elbow.
Squeeze the lat for a moment, then slowly let the handle return.
Keep your torso still and shoulders down. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

10560.description: A bench press where you lower the bar and catch it quickly before pressing. It trains chest strength and control.
instructions: Lie on a bench with a spotter or safety pins set.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your chest under control.
Stop it just above the chest and press up.
Keep your feet planted and your shoulder blades pinched.

10752.description: A slow forward bend that rolls through the spine one segment at a time. It builds back and hamstring mobility.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Tuck your chin and roll down one vertebra at a time.
Let your arms hang toward the floor.
Reach only as far as is comfortable.
Reverse slowly to stand.
Move with control and keep the load light.

11264.description: A cable press on an incline bench. It shifts the work toward the upper chest with constant tension.
instructions: Set an incline bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand.
Plant your feet and pull your shoulder blades back.
Press the handles up and slightly together.
Squeeze your upper chest at the top.
Lower slowly to a comfortable stretch.

11648.description: A prone raise that moves the arms into a W shape to strengthen the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructions: Lie face down with arms bent and elbows out to the sides.
Rest your forehead lightly on the floor.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms and chest slightly.
Form a W shape with your arms and hold for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.

11904.description: A half-kneeling position that opens the front of the hip and the quad of the back leg.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a pad under your knee.
Keep your torso upright and tuck your pelvis under.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your core engaged.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

0064.description: A bent-over row holding the bar in one hand at a time. Trains the upper back and lats.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a barbell with one hand using an overhand grip.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your head in a neutral position.
Pull the barbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，用一只手正握握住杠铃。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，头部处于中立位置。
将杠铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
以受控的方式将杠铃降低回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0128.description: Wave the heavy ropes rhythmically to raise heart rate and challenge the shoulders and arms.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold one end of the rope in each hand, with your palms facing each other.
Raise your arms to shoulder height, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Begin making alternating waves with the ropes by rapidly raising and lowering each arm.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手握住绳子的一端，手掌相对。
将手臂举至肩膀高度，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
快速抬起和放下每只手臂，开始用绳索产生交替的波浪。
继续所需的持续时间或重复次数。

0192.description: A one-arm cable lateral raise. You lift the arm out to the side until it is level, targeting the side delt.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the cable machine.
Hold the cable handle with one hand, palm facing down, and stand far enough away from the machine so that there is tension on the cable.
Keep your arm straight and slowly raise it out to the side until it is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，面向绳索机。
用一只手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝下，站得离机器足够远，以便电缆上有张力。
保持手臂伸直，慢慢向一侧举起，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0256.description: A shoulder warm-up where you draw circles with your elbows. It loosens the joint and prepares it for training.
instructions: Stand tall with your fingertips on your shoulders.
Raise your elbows out to the sides.
Draw big circles with your elbows.
Do several circles forward.
Reverse and circle backward.
Keep your neck relaxed and your breathing steady.

0320.description: A hammer curl performed sitting back on an incline bench. The neutral grip works the brachialis and biceps.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso and arms fully extended.
Keep your back against the bench and your feet flat on the floor.
While keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在上斜凳上，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干，手臂完全伸展。
背部靠在长凳上，双脚平放在地板上。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0384.description: A preacher curl with an overhand grip. It strengthens the biceps, the arm flexor beneath them and the forearms.
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad and your chest against the support.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbells as you contract your biceps.
Continue to curl the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在牧师凳上，上臂放在垫子上，胸部靠在支撑物上。
每只手握住一个哑铃，反握，手掌朝上。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯曲哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续弯举哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0448.description: Lying on a decline bench, you lower an EZ bar toward your face with a close grip and press up. It strongly works the triceps.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet.
Grasp the ez barbell with a close grip, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight up above your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Lower the barbell towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then press the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，头低于脚。
紧紧抓住 ez 杠铃，手掌相对。
将手臂伸直至胸部上方，保持肘部靠近身体。
弯曲肘部，将杠铃降低到前额。
暂停片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0576.description: A machine press where you push the handles forward from your chest. Works the chest, front shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back flat against the pad.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Push the handles forward until your arms are fully extended, exhaling during the movement.
Pause briefly at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position, inhaling as you do so.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，背部平放在垫子上。
正手握住手柄，肘部呈 90 度角。
向前推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，运动过程中呼气。
动作结束时短暂暂停，然后慢慢回到起始位置，同时吸气。
重复所需的重复次数。

0640.description: You lift a medicine ball overhead with one hand and slam it to the floor. Builds explosive power in the shoulders, core and lats.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the medicine ball with one hand in front of your waist.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Raise the medicine ball above your head, fully extending your arm.
Forcefully slam the medicine ball down to the ground, using your core and shoulders to generate power.
Catch the medicine ball on the bounce and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手将健身球放在腰前。
稍微弯曲膝盖并启动核心。
将健身球举过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
用力将药球摔到地上，用你的核心和肩膀产生力量。
抓住弹起的实心球，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0768.description: A single-leg split squat using the smith bar for balance, with the back foot raised. It trains the quads and glutes one side at a time.
instructions: Stand in front of the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place one foot behind you on a bench or step, with your toes pointing forward.
Hold onto the smith machine bar for stability.
Bend your front knee and lower your body down into a lunge position, keeping your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 站在史密斯机前，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将一只脚放在身后的长凳或台阶上，脚趾向前。
握住史密斯机杆以保持稳定性。
弯曲前膝盖，将身体降低到弓步位置，保持背部挺直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动前脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

0832.description: A crunch holding a weight on the chest. It strengthens the abs with added resistance.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell on your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your shoulder blades are off the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将杠铃片或哑铃放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到肩胛骨离开地面。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0960.description: Fold forward from a wide-legged stance to stretch the inner thighs and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Hinge forward at the hips with a long spine.
Lower your hands to the floor or your shins.
Relax your head and neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
